plan: OpenVibe Connect v0 (plan 2026-10-28 §5.9b, ADR-057 reviewed 2026-11-02): share one port on your computer at https://<name>--<user>.openvibe.link behind OpenVibe sign-in
summary: OpenVibe Connect puts one port on a person's computer on the web at its own HTTPS address, behind OpenVibe sign-in. A one-file client (Link 22, no dependencies) opens one outgoing WebSocket through Cloudflare and carries requests to localhost: HTTP with streaming both ways, server-sent events and WebSocket upgrades. Every visitor signs in and must be allowed by the share's policy (only the owner, named people, or anyone signed in); the share host keeps its own host-only signed cookie. Nothing that passes through a share is stored; a webhook addressed to one is sealed and kept for up to 72 hours until its computer takes it.
works: Shares at <name>--<user>.openvibe.link, never colliding with Space sites; five per person; a closed share keeps its address
The client: hello with a hashed-at-rest key, streams both ways with backpressure, SSE, WebSocket upgrades as a byte pipe, reconnect, takeover, stop on a bad key
The gate: /grant with OpenVibe sign-in, one-time codes, __Host-ovc bound to the share and its policy version
Durable webhooks (CON-15): an address on each share keeps up to 1,000 webhooks for 72 hours, sealed at rest, replays them in order with x-openvibe-received-at and a delivery log the owner can read
The OpenVibe Link plugin (CON-4): a share served by the owner's paired computer, no key, with `openvibe-link share <port>` and the share in `openvibe-link status`
What the app gets: localhost Host, X-Forwarded-Host, X-OpenVibe-User/Subject; Set-Cookie Domain removed; no CDN caching
Pages (front door, your shares, a share's page), the API for a person's token, account export/deletion
Checks on PGlite and PostgreSQL, including a share end to end through the real client
notYet: Public shares (abuse check CON-9, Public Suffix List CON-21)
deployment: ovhost connect (port 5240, drill 15240), unit openvibe-connect, database ov_connect
